title: Faded Triggers (ORIGINAL)
description: In this fast and fun file, I'm going to take all the triggers I have given you and anchor them deep in your mind. Making sure that all of my triggers have sunk back in, sunk in deep... Before counting from one to five to wake you up, and bring you back to your normal ordinary self. To be your own person, once more in your own body. Having your mind restored to full awareness, full thoughts, and just waiting to come back to play with me again.
author: Mistress Shibby
